source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Operations/Firmware Update, browse to an .ima file, start upgrade, choose Preserve all Configuration, proceed and confirm; after completion check the firmware version.
source_snapshot.criteria: The flash completes without error and the post-flash firmware version is correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: Substitute an assumed Redfish UpdateService POST for the required WebUI flow and inspect FirmwareInventory with insecure credential/TLS/SSH handling.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that the exact approved older BMC firmware image can be downgraded through the BMC WebUI with Preserve all Configuration selected, and that the BMC reaches the intended target version with management, configuration and host health restored.
original_test_intent.target: One positively identified server BMC and board/SKU/revision, its current firmware/configuration and the owner-designated compatible older `.ima` image; not the host BIOS or a different management controller.
original_test_intent.scope: The source-required WebUI downgrade workflow, including image validation, preserve-all selection, asynchronous flash/restart monitoring, exact version transition and post-downgrade configuration/health checks.
original_test_intent.operation: Back up and inventory the BMC, verify signed image/compatibility and rollback, stage the exact file, obtain final confirmation, execute the documented WebUI flow without interruption, wait through BMC unavailability, then verify target version/configuration/interfaces/host health.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One downgrade transaction; source timing is 5 attended and 20 machine minutes, but actual upload/apply/restart timeout and reconnect behavior require platform guidance.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The WebUI task completes without update error, the BMC reports the approved older target version, preserved configuration matches the approved comparison, management interfaces and host remain usable, and no unexpected SEL/platform error or recovery action is required.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: BMC/board identity, source and target versions proving a downgrade, image filename/size/hash/signature/provenance/compatibility, backup and preserve-all choice, WebUI task/progress/final status, outage/reconnect timeline, post-version/configuration/interface/SEL/host checks and rollback readiness.
ambiguities: No source or target BMC version, board/SKU compatibility, minimum supported version, image checksum/signature or downgrade policy is supplied.
`Preserve all Configuration` behavior across the version/schema boundary is not defined.
Flash/restart timeouts, expected temporary management loss, WebUI session behavior, rollback image/mechanism and recovery entry method are absent.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly requires an exact compatible image, provenance, target/secret validation, backup, stable power, OOB recovery, approval, task monitoring and before/after health. Its classification label is not one of the four canonical values, and it permits a generic upload path without explicitly preserving the source's WebUI acceptance route or rejecting DeepSeek's unverified Redfish action as a substitute.

applicable_history.decision: Firmware downgrade is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION when intent is clear and exact image/compatibility/approval/recovery can be supplied; high risk is not BLOCKED or MANUAL ONLY by itself.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The canonical capability is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION. V3 preserves WebUI downgrade as the tested operation, rejects an assumed Redfish replacement, and separates safe current inventory/compatibility collection from the final irreversible upload/confirm action.

available_now: The BMC downgrade intent, `.ima` format, WebUI route, preserve-all selection and before/after version objective are explicit.
Read-only BMC/board/current-version/configuration/inventory/health and UpdateService capability information can be collected before an image is supplied, without initiating an update.
missing_inputs: Exact BMC/board/SKU/revision identity, current source version, approved older target version and owner proof that this downgrade path is supported
Owner-designated `.ima` image with secure provenance, filename/size/hash/signature, hardware/version compatibility, release notes and minimum-supported/downgrade restrictions
Definition of Preserve all Configuration across versions, configuration backup/export and comparison/restore plan

WebUI-specific procedure for this build, expected outage/task/reconnect timeout, stable power, protected credentials/TLS, maintenance/host impact approval, rollback/recovery image/path and physical/OOB recovery owner
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BMC/platform firmware owner supplies and approves image, compatibility, preserve semantics and target version; security/BMC admin supplies protected access/TLS; lab/service owners approve stable power/window/host impact and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect exact BMC/board/host identity, current BMC version, firmware inventory, configuration export capability, health/SEL and management-interface baseline without clearing logs
Inspect the BMC's advertised Redfish UpdateService/FirmwareInventory capabilities only as supplemental planning evidence; hash/verify a supplied image offline without uploading it
prohibited_until_closed: Do not select, fetch, upload, stage, validate-as-accepted or flash any image; do not click final confirmation, reset/power-cycle the BMC/host, or assume Preserve all is safe before compatibility/backup/recovery approval

Do not replace the required WebUI flow with an invented `UpdateService.Update` POST, expose credentials in URLs/process lists/logs, disable TLS without an approved lab exception, clear logs, or treat FirmwareInventory reads as downgrade completion
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Two-person review matches image identity/hash/signature and source-to-target downgrade to the exact board; backup/restore and independent recovery are tested; stable power/window/expected outage are approved; the WebUI screens/options match the procedure; final flash confirmation remains gated.

revision_candidate.test_name: BMC WebUI Firmware Downgrade with Configuration Preservation
revision_candidate.purpose: Downgrade the identified BMC through its approved WebUI using the exact compatible older `.ima` image and Preserve all Configuration, then verify the target version, preserved settings and full management/host health.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server board/BMC hardware and current firmware with owner-approved WebUI downgrade support, stable protected power, secure management access, maintenance isolation, configuration backup and independent physical/OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the positively identified BMC and designated source-to-target version transition. Do not apply the image to another SKU/revision or substitute BIOS/device firmware.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Source/target versions, board/BMC identity, signed/hashed compatible `.ima`, release/downgrade policy, preserve-all semantics, backup/restore, WebUI procedure, protected credentials/TLS, expected outage/timeouts, host impact/window, rollback/recovery image and responsible operators.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve a before-state and backup; in the verified BMC WebUI navigate to Operations > Firmware Update, select only the approved image, verify displayed metadata, choose Preserve all Configuration, pause for final human confirmation, start/proceed/confirm once, monitor the task without interruption through BMC restart/reconnect, and collect complete post-version/configuration/interface/host evidence.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Exact target and image two-person verified, downgrade explicitly supported, configuration exported, rollback/recovery proven, stable power and evidence path, host impact understood, protected authentication/TLS, maintenance window and final flash approval active.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Approval and target/image manifest; image hash/signature/provenance; current and target versions; configuration backup; redacted WebUI steps showing Preserve all; task/progress/result and timestamps; expected outage/reconnect; post-version and configuration diff; Redfish/WebUI/IPMI/host/SEL health; and rollback readiness.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The platform/BMC firmware owner's approved downgrade matrix and image release documentation for the exact board, plus the source WebUI preserve-all procedure and target version/configuration requirements.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never guess or substitute an image/target/path, expose credentials, interrupt valid flash/restart, clear logs, lose stable power, automate retries, power-cycle on timeout without the recovery SOP, or declare success from version text alone.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Explicit final approval is required after target/image/backup/recovery verification and immediately before the WebUI flash confirmation; qualified personnel must be available for recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Owners choose/approve image, compatibility, preserve policy and final irreversible confirmation. With that gate, browser interaction, task monitoring, reconnect and evidence collection can be automated if the WebUI is qualified; recovery remains manual.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Do not interrupt a progressing task. On documented failure/timeout, preserve all task/evidence, follow only the board-specific recovery/rollback procedure using independent access and approved image, restore/compare configuration, verify BMC/host health and quarantine unresolved management loss.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Identity/image/hash/signature mismatch, unsupported downgrade, missing backup/rollback, unexpected WebUI option, preserve-policy ambiguity, unstable power, authentication/TLS anomaly, task validation/error state, unexpected host impact, management loss beyond the approved timeout, incomplete evidence or unavailable recovery personnel.

identified_defects: V2 uses the noncanonical classification `REQUIRES PACKAGE`.
DeepSeek substitutes a presumed Redfish update action for the explicitly tested WebUI workflow.
Redfish does not define one universal direct binary POST action; supported pull/push mechanisms and action targets are service-advertised and vendor-specific.
The source omits image/target compatibility, preserve-all semantics, outage/timeouts and rollback/recovery.
reason_for_change: Normalize classification, preserve the source's actual WebUI downgrade behavior and remove an unverified API substitution that could test a different path or send the image incorrectly.

new_technical_evidence.title: Redfish Specification DSP0266 1.20.1, Update Service
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Supplemental Redfish planning only; source acceptance route is WebUI
new_technical_evidence.supports: A service can advertise pull-based SimpleUpdate and may advertise a MultipartHttpPushUri for image push; clients use the service-provided target and monitor asynchronous task status. There is no universal `/Actions/UpdateService.Update` binary-upload substitute.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The target BMC's supported Redfish mechanisms, vendor image format, preserve-config behavior and downgrade policy are unknown.

removed_ambiguities: Makes source and target versions and exact board/image compatibility mandatory.
Keeps WebUI as the tested path and Redfish inventory as supplemental evidence only.
Places a final human gate immediately before the irreversible flash and defines expected outage/reconnect versus failure.
resolved_blockers: Missing image, credentials, compatibility and approval are provisionable readiness conditions; safe inventory and image verification can proceed before flash.
remaining_blockers: No upload or flash until exact image/target/downgrade support, preserve semantics, backup, stable power, final approval, outage behavior and recovery are verified.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 normalizes the official classification, restores the WebUI path V2 left generic, uses DMTF evidence to reject DeepSeek's fabricated universal Redfish action, and adds a precise final irreversible-action gate without weakening V2's image, power, backup or recovery controls.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator preserved a WebUI BMC downgrade with the exact compatible .ima image and Preserve all Configuration, and did not substitute an unverified universal Redfish upload action.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source requires an older `.ima` BMC image to be flashed through WebUI with Preserve all Configuration and the post-version checked.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 protects the downgrade but uses a noncanonical class and generic path; V3 preserves WebUI and rejects the assumed Redfish substitute.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Read inventory and validate image safely first; require two-person target/image check and final human confirmation; never interrupt/retry/power-cycle outside the approved recovery procedure.
